article_summaries.title: Free Realms Celebrates 20 Million Registered Players!
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced that more than 20 million users had registered for Free Realms since its April 28, 2009 launch. To celebrate, a Letterman Jacket was given away to players who logged in and claimed it between October 21 and October 31, 2011, and the Community Team held dance parties in Sanctuary on October 21, 2011.
